newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India issues third tender to buy Nov fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: India issues third tender to buy Nov fuel oil.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy 14,000 tonnes of fuel oil for delivery in November, industry sources said on Monday.
The cargo of 180 centistoke, 3.5 percent sulphur grade fuel oil is to be delivered between November 15-18 to Mangalore or Goa on the west coast of India.
The tender closes October 31 and will be valid until November 1.

India has already tendered to buy a total of 50,000 tonnes of fuel oil in November. Its tender to buy 25,000 tonnes for delivery between November 6-10 for delivery to Bombay, west coast of India, was valid until last Friday.
Industry sources said the tender is expected to be awarded later Monday.

IOC has also tendered to buy 25,000 tonnes of fuel oil for for delivery to Kandla also on the west coast of India between November 16-20. The tender will close on October 31 and is valid until Noveember 1.
